channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: "Every game will be cut-throat"
item.description: Antrim coach Seoirse Bulfin says the Saffrons are in for "a fair test" this weekend as they open their Allianz Hurling League Division 1B campaign away to Wexford.

item.title: Good start "vital" to Rebels' promotion hopes, says Collins
item.description: Former Cork forward Mark Collins says a good start will be "vital" for the Rebels if they are to get themselves in the hunt for promotion out of Division 2 in the Allianz Football League.

item.title: "We're striving to be our own team and win our own All-Irelands"
item.description: Dublin defender Greg McEneaney says the current crop of Dubs players are striving to be their own team.

item.title: Maher named new Galway football captain as Joyce shows hand for league opener
item.description: John Maher has been named as Galway's new senior football captain for the 2026 season.

item.title: Fitzgibbon Cup quarter-finals set after UCC see off Garda College
item.description: Next week's quarter-final fixtures for the Fitzgibbon Cup have been confirmed following UCC's win over Garda College in Templemore yesterday (Thursday).

item.title: Nugent to make Antrim return in goal
item.description: Domhnall Nugent is set to make his first start for Antrim's senior hurlers since 2023 when the Saffrons take on Wexford in their Allianz League Division 1B opener tomorrow (Saturday).

item.title: "There'll be no simple games" - Meenagh
item.description: Derry manager Ciaran Meenagh says "there'll be no simple games" as his side get set to embark on their Allianz Football League campaign this weekend.

item.title: Brennan hands Shaw and Kennedy Dublin debuts for Croker clash against Donegal
item.description: Ger Brennan has named his starting line-up for his first competitive outing since taking the reins as Dublin senior football manager.

item.title: GAA on TV: Eight live games for fans to watch as 2026 Allianz Leagues set to get underway
item.description: A host of games are set to be televised live this weekend as the 2026 Allianz Football and Hurling League competitions get underway.

item.title: "I definitely have big boots to fill with those girls that have gone before me as captain"
item.description: She has played alongside some notable figures during her time as part of the panel, but now Niamh Gallogly has been charged with leading Meath into battle for the 2026 inter-county season.
